![What Is Objectives And Key Results (OKR) | An Introduction ...](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/10081734-2633-0066-0000-94f8d7e4047e:4)
OKRs (`Objectives and Key Results`) are a popular goal-setting framework used by organizations and teams to define ambitious goals and track measurable progress.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yzF27WK8-MA)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/BXSxgIVEZVo)

### Core Components

- **Objective:** A qualitative, inspiring statement of what you want to achieve. It answers *what* is most important.[[1]](https://mooncamp.com/okr)[[2]](https://www.ibm.com/think/topics/okrs)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QULWaxmdcdI)
- **Key Results:** A set of 2 to 5 measurable metrics that track progress toward the objective. They define *how* success will be measured.[[1]](https://www.atlassian.com/agile/agile-at-scale/okr)[[2]](https://www.ibm.com/think/topics/okrs)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/BXSxgIVEZVo)
- **Initiatives:** The actual projects, tasks, and actions taken to drive the key results.[[1]](https://mooncamp.com/okr)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/pT1CxLboKO8)

### Key Benefits

- **Focus:** Narrows attention on top priorities during a specific cycle (usually quarterly).[[1]](https://www.whatmatters.com/faqs/okr-meaning-definition-example)[[2]](https://mooncamp.com/okr)
- **Alignment:** Connects daily work and team efforts to the broader company vision.[[1]](https://www.ibm.com/think/topics/okrs)
- **Transparency:** Makes goals visible across the entire organization.[[1]](https://balancedscorecard.org/okr-basics/)
- **Stretching:** Encourages ambitious "moonshot" targets where a 70% completion rate is often considered a success.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Objectives_and_key_results)[[2]](https://www.whatmatters.com/faqs/okr-meaning-definition-example)

### OKRs vs. KPIs

- **OKRs** drive change, growth, and new outcomes within a set timeframe.
- **KPIs (Key Performance Indicators)** monitor ongoing business health and standard operational performance.[[1]](https://www.workboard.com/resources/blog/okr-meaning)[[2]](https://mooncamp.com/okr)
